plain.li: No more fights, {OTHER_nameDef}, or the council will decide what comes next.
Everyone has had enough of the fighting, {OTHER_nameDef}, and so has the council.
The council asked me to tell you plainly that the fights stop now.
I'm not here to shout, only to say the council has seen enough fists for one month.
Keep your hands to yourself, {OTHER_nameDef}, because the council is watching.
[last] This is the last word the council will send you about the fights.
[last] One more fight, {OTHER_nameDef}, and it won't be words next time.

warm.li: I'd rather this came from a friend than from a vote, so please, no more fights.

blunt.li: Start one more fight and the council stops talking to you and starts talking about you.

cheerful.li: Let's get through a whole week with nobody's nose bleeding, shall we?

gloomy.li: I hate this part, but the council says the fighting has to stop.

cold.li: The council has counted every fight, and it is out of patience.

plain.li: I heard you, all right.
[defiant] They started it, whatever the council thinks.
[defiant] Then tell them to keep their mouths shut around me.
[sorry] I know, and I'm trying, I really am.
[sorry] It won't happen again, you have my word.
[bitter] Of course it's me you came to see, it's always me.
[bitter] Nobody here wants me around anyway, so what does it matter.

blunt.li: [defiant] Tell the council to mind its own business.

gloomy.li: [bitter] I knew someone would come about it sooner or later.

plain.li: The council has decided, {OTHER_nameDef}: you are to be {WORD}.
Gather your things, {OTHER_nameDef}, because the council says you are to be {WORD}.
The council voted, {OTHER_nameDef}, and you are to be {WORD} today.
You'll take what you wear and carry and go, {OTHER_nameDef}: you're {WORD}.
[warned] You were warned, {OTHER_nameDef}, and now you're to be {WORD}.
[apart] Even the nights apart didn't help, {OTHER_nameDef}, so you're to be {WORD}.

warm.li: I wish it were otherwise, {OTHER_nameDef}, but you are to be {WORD}.

blunt.li: That's it, {OTHER_nameDef}: you're {WORD}, and you go today.

gloomy.li: I'm sorry, {OTHER_nameDef}, but the council has you {WORD}.

cold.li: By the council's decision you are {WORD}, effective today.

plain.li: Then I'll get my things.
[defiant] Fine, I'll go, and you can all enjoy the quiet.
[defiant] You'll miss me the next time the raiders come.
[sorry] I understand, and I'm sorry it came to this.
[sorry] Tell the others I'm sorry, if any of them want to hear it.
[bitter] So that's what I was worth to all of you.
[bitter] I always knew it would end with me walking out alone.

blunt.li: [defiant] Took you long enough to say it.

plain.li: So this is how it ends here.
I'll find somewhere that wants me.
[defiant] Don't come looking for me, and I won't come looking for you.
[defiant] Good luck finding someone else to blame.
[sorry] Look after each other better than I managed to.
[sorry] I'd say goodbye properly, but I don't think anyone wants that.
[bitter] Not one of you is going to watch me go, are you.
[bitter] The road can't be worse company than this place was.

cheerful.li: Well, the world's a big place, and it's mine now.

cold.li: Goodbye, then, and I mean it.

plain.li: [for] We've talked and talked, and {OTHER_nameDef} keeps throwing punches.
[for] The colony is tired of walking round {OTHER_nameDef} on tiptoe.
[for] One more black eye at supper and someone will get hurt for real.
[against] We don't throw people away here, whatever they've done.
[against] {OTHER_nameDef} is one of us, and that should still count for something.
[against] Give {OTHER_nameDef} work away from the others, not the road.
[unsure] I don't know, and I don't think anyone should be sure.
[unsure] Something has to change, but I can't say it has to be this.
[unsure] Ask me after the next fight, and I'll probably know.

blunt.li: [for] Send {OTHER_nameDef} off and let us have some peace.

warm.li: [against] I can't vote to send anyone out there alone.

cold.li: [for] The colony works better without {OTHER_nameDef} in it, and the council knows it.

plain.li: You can't do this, not to {OTHER_nameDef}.
Send {OTHER_nameDef} away and I won't forget who voted for it.
[kin] If {OTHER_nameDef} goes, you're sending away part of me too.
[kin] You don't know {OTHER_nameDef} the way I do, and you never tried.
[friend] Every one of those fights had two people in it, not one.
[friend] {OTHER_nameDef} has been a friend to me when it counted.
Say what you like about me, I've done my share of the work.
[defiant] Half of those fights were started by people who couldn't keep quiet.
[defiant] Send me away if you like, but don't pretend I was the only one swinging.
[sorry] I know what I've been, and I'm asking for one more chance.
[sorry] I'll keep my head down and my hands to myself, I swear it.
[bitter] Nobody here has had a kind word for me in a month.
[bitter] You've all made up your minds about me, so why ask.
The council has decided: I'm to be {WORD}. I'm writing this with my pack on my back.
Last entry here. I'm {WORD}, and this book is staying behind with everything else.
They didn't look at me when it was said. Fine. I'll look at the road instead.
I don't know where I'll sleep tonight. Somewhere without them, at least.

warm.li: Whatever they think of me, I hope they're happy here. I mean that, mostly.

blunt.li: They call it being {WORD}. Fine words for kicking someone out.

cheerful.li: New start, whether I wanted one or not. Here's hoping the next place has better company.

gloomy.li: I always knew I'd end up on my own. Now it's official.

cold.li: The council's decision is made. I've packed what's mine. There is nothing left to write here.

plain.li: They sent {OTHER_nameDef} away today, and nobody asked me what I thought.
{OTHER_nameDef} is gone, {WORD} by the council's word. The room feels emptier.
I keep setting a place for {OTHER_nameDef} without thinking.
The council did what it thought was right. I can't forgive it yet.

warm.li: Wherever {OTHER_nameDef} is tonight, I hope there's a fire and someone kind beside it.

blunt.li: They threw {OTHER_nameDef} out. I'll remember every name that voted for it.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} will land on their feet. They always do. I just wish it were here.

gloomy.li: Gone. Just like that. I don't think I'll ever see {OTHER_nameDef} again.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has been sent away. I have opinions about that I won't write down.
